final: WITH region_counts AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(c.client_id) AS client_count FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), shares AS (SELECT region, client_count, 1.0 * client_count / SUM(client_count) OVER () AS share FROM region_counts), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT SUM(s.client_count) AS total_clients, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - a.value) AS average_amount_above_average_share FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.value
